claim_scope: First-party public-source chain for the exact public CPO software stack. This establishes structural tied-alias dead bookkeeping on the public 4B path without loading the full 4B model locally. It is not a PyTorch-2.8 runtime execution, not a full-Qwen RSS/file measurement, and not evidence about unreleased paper-table code.

public_cpo.mask_builder_behavior: Loads Transformers models with from_pretrained, materializes model.state_dict(), and computes per-tensor top-percent masks with no global threshold.
public_cpo.trainer_behavior: Consumes masks by model.named_parameters(); mask entries not exposed by duplicate-free parameter iteration cannot receive hooks or regularization.
public_cpo.public_history: src/compute_importance_mask.py has only the public release commit in its file history; the parent public tree contains only LICENSE and a tiny README, so this repository exposes no earlier public mask implementation from which paper-table semantics can be recovered.

pytorch_2_8_source.named_parameters_semantics: named_parameters defaults remove_duplicate=True and _named_members suppresses repeated member objects via a memo set.
pytorch_2_8_source.state_dict_semantics: _save_to_state_dict writes every registered parameter name and persistent buffer name; it does not apply duplicate-member filtering.
pytorch_2_8_source.comparison_to_2_10: The relevant duplicate-filter and state_dict-save bodies are structurally/textually equivalent in PyTorch v2.8.0 and v2.10.0 for the operations used by the prior synthetic harness. This narrows version risk but does not replace a direct 2.8 runtime run.

transformers_4_57_3_source.from_pretrained_tie_behavior: from_pretrained calls model.tie_weights() after construction and again after loading; tie_embeddings_and_encoder_decoder checks tie_word_embeddings and _tie_or_clone_weights assigns output_embeddings.weight = input_embeddings.weight when not torchscript.
transformers_4_57_3_source.qwen_structure: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration contains lm_head and wraps Qwen3VLModel; Qwen3VLModel registers visual then language_model; Qwen3VLTextModel registers embed_tokens. Public Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct config has tie_word_embeddings=true, hidden_size=2560, vocab_size=151936.
transformers_4_57_3_source.implication: On the public 4B path, lm_head.weight and the input embedding weight are the same Parameter object after from_pretrained tying. PyTorch state_dict preserves both registered names, whereas duplicate-free named_parameters exposes only one canonical Parameter path. Therefore the release mask builder can save an lm_head alias mask/reference that the trainer cannot consume.

conditional_payload_arithmetic.scope: Upper conditional logical-tensor arithmetic for this alias at 10% if all top-k movement values are nonzero. Public code drops zero-valued selected positions, so actual support can be smaller. These are not serialized-file or RSS measurements.

new_conclusions: The previous tied-alias synthetic finding is now supported by a complete first-party source chain across the public CPO release, pinned Transformers 4.57.3 tying logic, PyTorch 2.8 state_dict semantics, and PyTorch 2.8 duplicate-free named_parameters semantics.
The canonical trainer-namespace repair is specifically aligned with the public trainer's observable Parameter namespace and removes this dead alias without relying on storage identity.
Direct PyTorch-2.8 execution and real Qwen3-VL-4B file/RSS/runtime measurements remain required before claiming empirical overhead reduction on the full model.
